title: Made an AI Game Tester
author: OsrsNeedsF2P
selftext:
Hey all! If you're making games with AI inside of Godot, then you've probably heard of Ziva (https://ziva.sh/), but in case you haven't, it's basically the #1 MCP for Godot.

  
We recently rolled out a new playtesting feature for agents so they can find bugs automatically or help you prepare a QA release. Note the video here is an example of what the playtesting agent exports, but it takes 10x longer in real-time.

  
Right now it's rolled out on our paid tier, but once we iron out the bugs we'll move it to the free tier where you can use your Codex/Claude Code subscription on your own. Open to any feedback/improvement ideas!
